Cover: 1) Always prefer skill_execute/skill_list for reusable capabilities over ad-hoc tool chains. 2) Use the loop_executor for iterative think-act-observe cycles. 3) Leverage the brain_loop for plan-execute-reflect iteration with deep reasoning. 4) Register custom routes in FastPathCache for repeated task patterns. 5) Use the CacheLayer trait to expose cache metrics for governance.
